product_summary: Website suncrossbikes.com (About Us page) states the firm is promoted by Naren International, Ludhiana, a Govt. of India Recognized Export House, and sells under brands SUNCROSS, CICLOSPORT, BICISPORT; it also states it is official licensee/distributor of RALEIGH in India. Real catalogue: complete bicycles (MTB hard tail, full suspension, hybrid, DTB, city MTB, trekking, kids), e-bikes, plus a very broad spares/accessories line — mag wheels, alloy hubs, BB sets, brake sets and hydraulic disc brakes, chains, derailleurs, shifters, chainwheels/cranks, handle bars, stems, headsets, pedals, saddles, seat posts, suspension forks, rims, spokes, tyres, tubes, helmets, lights, locks, pumps, bags, clothing, cycling shoes. Named models: ZANE 21/24-speed, SLANGER, THEOS, CENTROS, DIRT JUMPER, RIO/EXPLORA saddles, DBM-5003 hydraulic disc brake set, KMC e8 Turbo chain.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — self-described exporter of complete bicycles and parts, but About Us explicitly says it also supplies 'Chinese/Taiwanese produced Bicycle Parts, Components, Tyres & Tubes & Accessories', and it distributes the RALEIGH brand as licensee. So a mix of own-brand assembly/manufacture and third-country trading/distribution. Trader signs present (brand licensing, distribution, Far-East sourcing base).
comment: HS 8712.00 is CORRECT and fully corroborated by the catalogue (complete bicycles are the core line). HS 4013.20 (inner tubes) is also a genuine product line on the site, so that code is legitimate — but note the site shows tubes/tyres as one of many accessory categories, not the main business. Industry label 'Авиастроение и транспорт' (aircraft & transport) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: there is no aviation content whatsoever; correct industry is bicycles / bicycle components (non-motorised vehicles, light transport). Product lines MISSING from the declaration: e-bikes (8711.60), all bicycle parts (8714.91–8714.99), tyres (4011.50), helmets (6506), electrical accessories (lights, speedometers), bags/clothing. Recommendation per Rule 3: keep the company, do not reject; correct/extend the HS list to 8712.00 + 8711.60 + 8714.xx + 4011.50 + 4013.20, verdict accepted_hs_corrected.
